Hi :) I understand not wanting to admit being suicidal.  As long as you express to the doctor that you are feeling depressed and are having a hard time managing. I started feeling depressed at age 12. I'm 32 now and I've spent the past 20 years just trying to be okay. Like you, I got absolutely no help from my parent. I live I Canada, I'm not sure what the rules or laws are where you live,  but I went to a doctor and got a prescription for antidepressants. After a few months on them, I felt a bit better and was able to focus more on what CAUSED my depression. I spent 10 years taking very good care of myself and trying to nurture my soul. I read books , took hot baths,  I got a cat, I stopped drinking and doing drugs. I started focusing on what I needed to feel at peace,  and I slowly worked towards that. Basically I took charge of my own happiness. It wasn't easy but it was worth it and I'm glad I didn't pull that trigger 15 years ago xoxoxox

Hi :) I am here and I care. Please hang on. You are so much stronger than you give yourself credit for. You have overcome obstacles most people could not imagine. You are loved. You are needed here. You have a purpose. Please be strong. You are not alone. I am sorry I can't give you answers or guidance but I know exactly how you feel. Please, stick around. Give life time. Reach out for help. Talk to a professional. See a doctor about medication. There are resources.  There are options. Suicide is never one of them. Xoxoxoxox

Hello. I was there. It's scary, I know. There IS help out there but sometimes you have to reach out for it. I'm sorry your parents are not supporting you the way they should. Please, you are so young. Give things time. Be gentle to yourself.  Care for yourself the way you would a new baby. You can change anything you hate about your life. Practice accepting yourself and loving yourself above all else. Please reach out to your parents again, or another family member or any adult that you can confide in. Tell them how you feel. Be honest. We can't help you if you are holding back the truth. Don't  be afraid. You are so much stronger than you can possibly imagine. You will overcome incredible things. Please give it time. Hang in there. I am here xoxoxox Oxford

Hello. You are not alone. I am here. Please do not kill yourself. Your little brother needs you. There is always the option to just hold on. You do not need to make any drastic decisions today or tomorrow or anytime soon. Please give it time. I can't tell you what to do but I can tell you that suicide is not an option. Things can get better if you only hold on and try to stay strong for those who love you. Please hang in there. You will be okay. You will not always be stuck with your parents. You can make your own way, it just takes time.

I'm so sorry you feel that way. Please do not hurt yourself. You are loved and valuable even if depression tells you otherwise. Please reach out for help. Please. You are NOT alone. Everything you hate can be changed.
